title: Search or discovery poisoning
summary: A search result or promoted listing leads to an impostor support or payment destination.
scenario: The result looks official but the destination or contact path has not been independently checked.
warning_signs: Sponsored or unusual result for a known service
Request for remote access, payment, or codes
safe_actions: Do not rely on the first result for a sensitive action
Use a known bookmark, app, statement, or independently confirmed contact
Check the final destination before sign-in
recovery_guidance: Contact the real provider and payment service through known routes
reporting_guidance: Record the search result and destination
Use checked platform or reporting channels
prevention_tips: Treat search ranking as discovery, not verification
false_positive_notes: Search can surface legitimate support, but sensitive actions deserve a second verification path.
